description: This file defines the UnitConverterPage class, which provides methods to interact with the unit converter UI in a calculator application for testing purposes. It includes methods for clearing the display, ensuring the calculator is in currency mode, selecting units, and verifying the display state.

classes.name: UnitConverterPage
classes.description: Represents the unit converter page in the calculator UI, providing methods to interact with and verify the state of the unit converter during automated tests.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears the calculator display by clicking the clear button.

methods.name: EnsureCalculatorResultTextIsZero
methods.description: Checks if the calculator result is zero; if not, clears the display.

methods.name: NavigateToUnitConverter
methods.description: Navigates the calculator to the unit converter mode, specifically currency mode.

methods.name: EnsureCalculatorIsCurrencyMode
methods.description: Ensures the calculator is in currency mode by checking the page source and header, navigating if necessary.

methods.name: EnsureSameUnitsAreSelected
methods.description: Ensures that Units1 and Units2 are set to the same value.

methods.name: SelectUnits1
methods.description: Selects a specific unit in the Units1 ComboBox.

methods.name: SelectUnits2
methods.description: Selects a specific unit in the Units2 ComboBox.
